purpose: Real speech from the AMI Meeting Corpus (CC BY 4.0): four people introduce themselves at a kick-off. Outside the two-speaker scope, so the product should decline for that reason. Written before the first run.
traps: No list: drawing a favourite animal on the whiteboard is not a project task.
Short turns by two of the four people may be hard to tell apart; the result is still a decline as long as more than two voices are heard.
